newsitem.title: UK: UK mergers total 42.6 billion stg in first 9 mths.
newsitem.headline: UK mergers total 42.6 billion stg in first 9 mths.

text.p: The value of mergers and acquisitions in the UK totalled 42.6 billion stg during the first nine months of the year, up from 40.3 billion stg in the same period 1995, trade magazine Acquisitions Monthly said.
There were 1,239 deals from January to September 1996, compared with 1,168 in the year ago period.
Last year, the 1,724 mergers and acquisitions valued at 68.1 billion stg was a record.
"We only need a few more large deals to make 1996 an even bigger year -- the figures might even break through the 70 billion (stg) mark," said Philip Healey, editor of Acquisitions Monthly.
